title.en: Explain why a transistor must be biased
Draw the DC load line and locate the Q-point

say.en: A microphone signal is only a few millivolts, too small to switch on a silicon transistor. So we first give the transistor a steady DC operating condition and then ride the signal on top of it. In this lesson: Explain why a transistor must be biased.
Draw the DC load line and locate the Q-point.

body.en: *Biasing* means applying DC voltages so that the emitter–base junction is forward biased and the collector–base junction is reverse biased, with suitable zero-signal values of $I_B$, $I_C$ and $V_{CE}$. Without bias, the negative half of the signal and the part below 0.7 V would not be amplified. Proper bias keeps the transistor in the active region for the whole signal, giving faithful amplification.

points.en: Faithful amplification needs the transistor in the active region throughout
Zero-signal values: I_B, I_C and V_CE
Bias must also stay stable with temperature and β

narration.en: Biasing gives the transistor steady DC currents and voltages so that it stays in the active region for the whole input signal.
narration.kn: ಬಯಾಸಿಂಗ್ ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸಿಸ್ಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಡಿಸಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಮತ್ತು ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ನೀಡಿ, ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಕೇತಕ್ಕೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಸಕ್ರಿಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Biasing gives the transistor steady DC currents and voltages so that it stays in the active region for the whole input signal. Faithful amplification needs the transistor in the active region throughout.

title.en: On the board: DC load line and Q-point

say.en: In the collector circuit, the supply voltage is shared between the drop across RC and the transistor’s VCE.
Take VCC = 12 volts and RC = 2 kilo-ohms. This equation is a straight line on the output characteristics: the DC load line.
When VCE is zero, IC is VCC over RC, 6 milliamperes: the saturation point. When IC is zero, VCE is 12 volts: the cut-off point.
Now draw the output curves. With IB = 30 microamperes and beta 100, IC is 3 milliamperes, and the line gives VCE = 6 volts. That is the Q-point.
A Q-point near the middle of the line lets the signal swing both ways without clipping.
On the board: DC load line and Q-point.

narration.en: The load line VCE = VCC − IC RC joins the cut-off point (VCC, 0) and the saturation point (0, VCC/RC). The Q-point is where it crosses the output curve for the chosen base current (β = 100). For the largest undistorted swing the Q-point should sit near the middle.
narration.kn: ಭಾರ ರೇಖೆ VCE = VCC − IC RC, (VCC, 0) ಮತ್ತು (0, VCC/RC) ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆರಿಸಿದ ಆಧಾರ ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ವಕ್ರವನ್ನು ಅದು ದಾಟುವ ಬಿಂದು Q. ವಿರೂಪವಿಲ್ಲದ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಸ್ವಿಂಗ್‌ಗೆ Q ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರಬೇಕು.

title.en: DC load line and operating point

body.en: In the collector circuit $V_{CC} = I_C R_C + V_{CE}$. This is a straight line on the output characteristics, called the *DC load line*. It meets the $V_{CE}$ axis at $V_{CC}$ (cut-off point) and the $I_C$ axis at $V_{CC}/R_C$ (saturation point). The intersection of the load line with the output curve for the chosen $I_B$ is the operating point, or Q-point $(V_{CE}, I_C)$.

points.en: Q-point: best near the middle of the *load line*

narration.en: The load line joins the cut-off point, V C C on the voltage axis, to the saturation point, V C C over R C on the current axis. The Q-point sits on this line.
narration.kn: ಲೋಡ್ ರೇಖೆಯು ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲಿನ Vcc ಕಟ್-ಆಫ್ ಬಿಂದುವನ್ನು ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಮೇಲಿನ Vcc/Rc ಸ್ಯಾಚುರೇಶನ್ ಬಿಂದುವಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕ್ಯೂ-ಬಿಂದು ಈ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A CE amplifier has V_CC = 12 V and R_C = 3 kΩ. Find the end points of the DC load line. If I_C = 2 mA, find the Q-point.

steps.en: Cut-off point: I_C = 0, V_CE = V_CC = 12 V.
Saturation point: V_CE = 0, I_C = 12 V/3 kΩ = 4 mA.

answer.en: Load line from (12 V, 0) to (0, 4 mA); Q-point = (6 V, 2 mA), the middle of the line

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A CE amplifier has V_CC = 12 V and R_C = 3 kΩ. Find the end points of the DC load line. If I_C = 2 mA, find the Q-point.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A CE amplifier has V CC equals 12 volts and R C equals 3 k ohms. Find the end points of the DC load line. If I C equals 2 milliamperes, find the Q-point.
Cut-off point: I C equals 0, V CE equals V CC equals 12 volts.
Saturation point: V CE equals 0, I C equals 12 V over 3 k ohms equals 4 milliamperes.
At I C equals 2 milliamperes: V CE equals 12 minus 2 times 3 equals 6 volts.
So the answer is Load line from (12 volts, 0) to (0, 4 milliamperes); Q-point equals (6 volts, 2 milliamperes), the middle of the line.

points.kn: ಮಧ್ಯದ ಕ್ಯೂ-ಬಿಂದು ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿರೂಪರಹಿತ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Draw the DC load line for V_CC = 9 V and R_C = 1.5 kΩ and mark the Q-point for I_C = 3 mA.

narration.en: Recap. Biasing keeps the transistor in the active region for the whole signal. DC load line: V_CE = V_CC − I_C R_C. End points: (V_CC, 0) and (0, V_CC/R_C). Q-point near the middle gives the largest undistorted output.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಬಯಾಸಿಂಗ್ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಕೇತಕ್ಕೆ ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸಿಸ್ಟರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸಕ್ರಿಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಡಿಸಿ ಲೋಡ್ ರೇಖೆ: Vce = Vcc − Ic Rc. ಅಂತ್ಯ ಬಿಂದುಗಳು: (Vcc, 0) ಮತ್ತು (0, Vcc/Rc). ಮಧ್ಯದ ಕ್ಯೂ-ಬಿಂದು ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿರೂಪರಹಿತ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Biasing keeps the transistor in the active region for the whole signal.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಬಯಾಸಿಂಗ್ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಕೇತಕ್ಕೆ ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸಿಸ್ಟರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸಕ್ರಿಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: DC load line: V CE equals V CC - I C R C.
say.kn: ಡಿಸಿ ಲೋಡ್ ರೇಖೆ: Vce equals Vcc - Ic Rc.

say.en: End points: (V CC, 0) and (0, V CC over R C).
Q-point near the middle gives the largest undistorted output.
say.kn: ಮಧ್ಯದ ಕ್ಯೂ-ಬಿಂದು ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿರೂಪರಹಿತ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Next: Thermal runaway and stability factor.
say.kn: ಮುಂದೆ: ಉಷ್ಣ ರನ್‌ಅವೇ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿರತಾ ಅಂಶ.
